hero.title: Your amount. Your term. Your monthly repayment — instantly.
hero.subtitle: Move the slider and see in real time what your monthly repayment would be. No sign-up, no hidden fees.

simulator.title: Work out your repayment
simulator.subtitle: Adjust the amount and term — the calculation updates instantly.
simulator.rateNote: Representative annual rate (APR) 6.9% nominal / 7.4% effective. The actual offer depends on your personal assessment.
simulator.disclaimer: This simulation is for information only and does not constitute a binding offer.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to your loan
howItWorks.step1Text: Set the amount and term on the slider and see your monthly repayment instantly.
howItWorks.step2Text: Fill in a short form — the calculated figures carry over automatically.
howItWorks.step3Text: Our team reviews your application and gets back to you as quickly as possible.

features.title: Why HiterKredit
features.f1Text: You see every cost right from the simulator — no surprises in the contract.
features.f2Text: A simple form and quick response times from our team.
features.f3Text: We don't keep your personal data any longer than needed to process your application.
features.f4Text: Our team is on hand to answer any question about your loan.

countries.title: Available in your country
countries.subtitle: HiterKredit operates across several European countries and Puerto Rico, adapted to local language and practice.

about.title: Transparency, speed and responsible lending
about.intro: HiterKredit was founded with one goal: to make personal loans simple, transparent and accessible, wherever you live.
about.missionText: We believe a financial decision should be simple. That's why we built a simulator that shows the real cost of a loan in real time, and an application form that takes under two minutes.
about.value1Text: No hidden costs or small print to catch you out.
about.value2Text: We only collect the data needed to process your application.
about.value3Text: We lend responsibly and encourage you to work out what you can afford.
about.presenceText: We operate in Slovenia, Slovakia, Lithuania, Puerto Rico, the Netherlands/Flanders and Ireland, each adapted to the local language.

footer.riskNote: A loan is a financial commitment. Carefully consider your ability to repay before signing the contract.
